purpose: Require explicit full-frame component coverage before Dream Loop PRO scoring.

groups.name: Train, front to back
components: train.buffers: both buffer heads, shafts, plates, complete silhouettes and screen position
train.buffer-beam: scarlet beam proportions, brackets, bolts, wear and height
train.coupling: central hook, chain, hoses, attachment points and front mechanical mass
train.apron: shaped front apron, footplate, running boards and their structural connections
train.smokebox-form: door convexity, diameter, housing, seam and blackened-steel response
train.smokebox-fittings: latch, hinges, horizontal straps, number plate, rivets and lamp
train.chimney: stack, flare, rim, base, height and integration with boiler
train.front-cylinders: cylinder housings, piston rods, pipes and mountings
train.leading-wheels: leading wheels, axles, rail contact and visible supports
train.driving-wheels: each visible driving wheel, spokes, hubs, rims and splashers
train.running-gear: connecting rods, joints, springs, suspension and dark intervening machinery
train.boiler: barrel profile, taper, longitudinal length, bands, seams and oxblood paint
train.boiler-fittings: domes, valves, handrails, pipes, supports and local wear
train.cab: roof, windows, pillars, door, steps, interior depth and connection to boiler
train.tender: body, coal, wheels, coupling and transitions
train.near-carriage: first coach profile, window spacing, roof, trim, doors and undercarriage
train.middle-carriages: successive coach silhouettes, windows, connections and perspective spacing
train.distant-end: final visible train extent, atmospheric recession and relationship to terminal

groups.name: Opposing station, behind the train
components: opposite.platform: platform width, height, coping, edge wear and furniture
opposite.lower-facade: lower windows, doors, arches, recesses and interior illumination
opposite.upper-facade: upper storey, arched bays, window spacing and masonry infill
opposite.masonry: brick scale, mortar, pilasters, horizontal bands, cornices and soot
opposite.railings: fence location, posts, finials, rails and visual density
opposite.fixtures: lamps, brackets, signage and small wall details
opposite.columns: freestanding columns, bases, capitals and branching roof supports

groups.name: Roof and distant station
components: roof.overall: canopy span, height, curvature, ridge and coverage
roof.primary-trusses: deep curved chords, triangulated webs, plates and physical junctions
roof.secondary: longitudinal members, diagonal bracing, purlins and overlapping depth
roof.glazing: panel sizes, frames, dirt, transparency and sky visibility
roof.side-panels: side-roof material, seams, soot and relationship to supports
distance.upper-window: arched terminal glazing proportions, mullions and crossbeam
distance.lower-opening: continuation below terminal glazing, columns, buildings and open space
distance.depth: layered geometry, vanishing point, train recession and cool atmosphere

groups.name: Near platform and track
components: ground.paving: slab sizes, layout, variation, joints, edge damage and scale
ground.wetness: shallow irregular pooling, damp transitions and reflected-light continuity
ground.platform-edge: coping width, color, wear, height and perspective
track.rails: rail profile, parallel spacing, polished tops, rust and fastening
track.sleepers: spacing, wood grain, wear, fasteners and contact with ballast
track.ballast: stone size, distribution, darkness, coal grit, dirt and debris

groups.name: Right wall and foreground props
components: right.masonry: pier widths, arched bays, brick scale, mortar and projecting stonework
right.windows: frame profiles, mullions, glass, reflection and warm interior depth
right.lanterns: housings, glow, brackets, spacing and cast/reflected light
sign.face: sign diameter, screen position, aged enamel and exact numeral proportions
sign.bracket: wrought-iron scrolls, mountings, thickness and silhouette
props.bench: slats, seat/back proportions, curved arms, legs and screen placement
props.trolley: curved handle, tubing, tray, axle, wheels and wear
props.main-trunk: rounded leather thickness, seams, straps, locks, handles and corner hardware
props.other-luggage: each visible case, stacking, material variation and believable support
props.cage: size, placement, thin bars, dome, rings, finial, base and contents
props.blanket: folded volume, soft silhouette, layered fabric, fringes and placement
props.small-details: clocks, notices, additional luggage and station dressing

groups.name: Cross-frame lighting and image quality
components: light.exposure: highlight/shadow balance without clipping or crushed important forms
light.palette: cool roof/distance against warm brick, lamps and reflected amber
light.reflections: shape, intensity, color and location on each major surface
light.chimney-steam: plume origin, shape, breadth, drift, translucency and illumination
light.wheel-steam: low rolling steam, occlusion, spread and interaction with running gear
light.depth-haze: layered atmosphere and distant visibility
image.artifacts: noise, aliasing, geometry intersections, floating pieces, repetition and cropping
